summary: ADR-0057 accepted 2026-08-05; knowledge publication owned solely by maintain-knowledge-base via separate append-only, maintainer-confirmed request; request binds caller, trigger, one existing target plan at pinned main, current local main commit, timestamp, non-automatic status, knowledge-publication authority, and hash-verified stale maintenance route; publish_knowledge_catalog.py --publish fails closed without bindings; Acceptance stale route is typed, hash-bound, non-authorizing, append-only; VDD/Acceptance reject outputs outside exact target directory; global plan indexing includes stable semantic sources only, excludes authority manifests and knowledge contexts to prevent recursive closure; standalone builder read-only, publication gate alone activates formal layers/pointers with validated capability; versioned top-level requirements/contract/state/registry files select highest numeric version, supporting requirements-ledger and requirements names; historical/read-only checks remain compatible, new publications record summary and hash; extends ADR-0044/0048/0050, supersedes none
